'''Chris Libey''' was Decipher [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]] Gold 88 in Blacksburg, VA, later Richmond, VA. The slot is marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" />

His profile was a short greeting as the new Gold 88.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
